observations.title: Brand ALL and OHORA have different visible dashboard states
observations.claim: Historical screenshot comparison reports changed counts, chart series, and panel after the selected brand differs. No click-event trace was captured or independently replayed here.

observations.title: Client-versus-server filtering mechanism not established
observations.claim: The historical observations cannot establish whether client code, a backend API, static JSON, or n8n caused the displayed changes.

observations.title: Original ratio and engagement formulas not audited
observations.claim: The displayed percentages and average reaction values were copied from screenshots as reported, not validated against original raw data or calculation code.
